record.paper_title: Some Open Questions in Analysis for Dirichlet Series
record.original_question: Determine the asymptotic behavior, as N tends to infinity, of the H^p norm of the Dirichlet polynomial sum_{n=1}^N n^{-1/2-s} for 0 < p ≤ 1.

evidence.quote: Problem 4.3. Determine the asymptotic behavior of ||PN n=1 n−1/2−s||Hp when N → ∞ for 0 < p ≤ 1.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
For a complex variable $s$, consider the Dirichlet polynomial
$$P_N(s)=\sum_{n=1}^{N} n^{-1/2-s}.$$
For $0<p<\infty$, let $\mathcal{H}^p$ denote the Hardy space of Dirichlet series, defined as the completion of the space of Dirichlet polynomials $f(s)=\sum_{n=1}^{M} a_n n^{-s}$ with respect to the norm
$$\|f\|_{\mathcal{H}^p}=\left(\lim_{T\to\infty}\frac{1}{2T}\int_{-T}^{T}|f(it)|^{p}\,dt\right)^{1/p}\qquad(p<\infty),$$
(equivalently, by the Bohr lift, $\mathcal{H}^p$ is isometrically isomorphic to $H^p(\mathbb{T}^\infty)$ with respect to normalized Haar measure on the infinite-dimensional polytorus).

Determine, for each $p$ with $0<p\le 1$, the asymptotic behavior of $\|P_N\|_{\mathcal{H}^p}$ as $N\to\infty$.
artifact.status_search_result: The problem is listed as an open question concerning the H^p norms of the partial sums of the zeta function on the critical line for 0 < p ≤ 1. While related results exist on Hardy spaces of Dirichlet series (Saksman–Seip, Aleman–Olsen, etc.), no resolution of the asymptotic behavior in this range was found in the search results, and it appears to remain open.

status_evidence.title: Hardy Spaces of Dirichlet Series and the Riemann Zeta Function (Seip)
status_evidence.snippet: Discussion of H^p norms of partial sums of zeta on the critical line; behavior for p ≤ 1 listed among open questions.
status_evidence.claim: The asymptotic behavior of the H^p norms of the truncated zeta series on the critical line for 0<p≤1 is presented as an open problem.

status_evidence.title: Hardy Spaces of Dirichlet Series
status_evidence.snippet: Survey of Hardy spaces H^p of Dirichlet series and their norms.
status_evidence.claim: No resolution given for the asymptotic of ||sum n^{-1/2-s}||_{H^p} for 0<p≤1.
